the development of structure-preserving Krylov subsapce-based reduction algorithms for general RLC circuits.
the development of structure-preserving Krylov subsapce-based model order reduction methods for RCL circuits.

SPRIM is a very promising new technique for the solution of the structure-preserving model reduction problem of large RCL circuit equations.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structure-preserving model reduction of general RLC circuits is a challenging problem.

SPRIM is a more accurate and reliable method than PRIMA for structure-preserving model reduction of large RCL circuits.
